hypotheses.novelty: No prior lane fuses basin thickness × dilation-gated conductivity × gravity Laplacian as product; H86F-EWCS used corridors not Zb-gated, H86D-CTHB used cond halos not dilation-gated, concentration/relief only reshuffled H19-5.

hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Volcanic flow fronts, intrusive contacts; require mag+grav coincidence.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: High where mag source strong. Cost MEDIUM (FFT LoG).

hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Medium (Walker Lane limited domain). Cost MEDIUM-HIGH.
